summary: Iter81 Phase 3 — Reactive Progression + Your Progress. Backend: 22/22 pass (19 existing pure-module + HTTP tests in test_iter81_phase3_progression.py + 3 NEW live-DB integration tests in test_iter81_phase3_integration.py). Integration tests seeded 3 planned workouts (Mon/Wed/Fri) in a fresh future ISO week (2027-W31) and verified via direct MongoDB checks that (a) no snapshot is created after completing 1/3, (b) no snapshot after 2/3, (c) snapshot IS created in progression_snapshots after 3/3 with correct week_key, sessions_planned=3, sessions_completed=3, adherence 100%, status_label PROGRESSING, and the POST /workouts/{wid}/complete response includes _progression_snapshot only on the final completion. Rule-engine coverage verified for all 4 statuses (progressing_well, maintain, reduce_load, deload), high-RPE thresholds, missed-key-session logic, placeholder-workout exclusion, empty week, and status_label/reason/coach_note enrichment. HTTP endpoints (/progress/current, /progress/history?weeks=0..100, /progress/recompute, /coach/clients/{cid}/progress/{current,history}) all return well-formed responses with correct 403/200 role gates. Frontend: mobile viewport 390x844, logged in as client via UI, forced snapshot via POST /api/progress/recompute (returned status=reduce_load, sessions_planned=7 for current real client data in week 2026-W30). Verified: (1) ProgressCard testID progress-card renders on /home between HotelSetupCard and event card, showing PULL BACK pill + reason + metrics strip (0/7 SESSIONS, 0% ADHERENCE, — AVG RPE); (2) tapping card navigates to /your-progress; (3) header renders your-progress-back + progress-recompute-btn; (4) snapshot list renders 1 card testID snap-2026-W30 with '20 Jul → 26 Jul' date range, status pill, reason, and metrics; (5) recompute button click succeeds and refreshes list; (6) back button navigates to /home. No red screen, no page errors, only benign RN web deprecation warnings (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents, tintColor, useNativeDriver — pre-existing across app).
critical_code_review_comments: feature_progression.py: clean pure module (~290 lines), well-commented, no side effects in compute_status. Rule engine order is documented and correct (DELOAD > REDUCE(adherence) > REDUCE(avg_rpe) > REDUCE(key_missed) > PROGRESSING > MAINTAIN fallback).
on_workout_completed trigger correctly filters to _is_planned (has exercises or warmup), so placeholder days do not block snapshot creation. Trigger fires exactly once per week when remaining=0.
compute_and_store_week uses upsert with force flag so /recompute is idempotent — no duplicate snapshots per (user_id, week_key).
server.py /progress/history clamps weeks to [1,52]; /coach/clients/{cid}/progress/* correctly gated behind require_role('coach').
workout_complete endpoint wraps trigger in try/except so a progression failure never fails the complete request (non-fatal).
ProgressCard.tsx correctly returns null while loading and when snap has no status → no phantom card when snapshot is {}.
your-progress.tsx renders SafeAreaView(edges=['top']) + proper RefreshControl; empty state testID your-progress-empty gated behind snapshots.length === 0.
Both cards use consistent STATUS_COLOR mapping and testIDs. week_key is used as key + testID (stable and unique).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 testIDs render, navigation Home ↔ /your-progress works, recompute + back flows verified)

seed_data_creation: Integration test seeded 3 planned workouts on 2027-08-02/04/06 (ISO week 2027-W31) for client@crewfit.com and cleaned them up + the resulting snapshot in fixture teardown. Frontend test triggered POST /api/progress/recompute for the current week (2026-W30) which persisted a real snapshot with status=reduce_load, sessions_planned=7 (based on real client workouts). This snapshot reflects genuine client state and is left in place — /recompute is idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter81 Phase 3 Reactive Progression is production-ready. Backend: 22/22 tests pass, endpoints all well-formed. Frontend: ProgressCard shown on client /home only when a snapshot exists (data-dependent — hide when {} returned). Tap navigates to /your-progress with header (your-progress-back + progress-recompute-btn) and snap-<week_key> list cards. To force a snapshot for future frontend testing: login as client (client@crewfit.com/Client123!), POST /api/progress/recompute with bearer token — this creates a snapshot for the current ISO week using whatever workouts exist. Client currently has snapshot for 2026-W30 (status=reduce_load, 0/7 completed). To test empty state (your-progress-empty), you'd need to delete all snapshots for user first: db.progression_snapshots.delete_many({'user_id': <cid>}) then reload /your-progress. On-completion snapshot trigger only fires when remaining=0 planned workouts in the ISO week (verified via integration test).
